prior_work.finding: The same separate queue-read race and a joint observation/queue snapshot direction were described before this audit. The 10 October initial review did not find that comment. Credit this as existing upstream work; the local evidence adds source-bound controls, not a novelty or collaboration claim.

research.title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
research.finding: The learning objective distinguishes committed, executed and discarded chunk regions. Its current scheduler requires a fixed inference budget, and its bounded residual corrections cannot arbitrarily repair a deficient base policy.

research.title: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
research.finding: Six methods are compared on a 10 Hz bimanual platform; five trials per method/task and milestone completion scores limit extrapolation. Blending, continuity and precision are distinct concerns.

engineering_decision: Qualify the relative-action path already touched by the candidate, then test the prior joint-snapshot proposal against an observation/queue interleaving. Keep production APIs and physical experiments unchanged.

hypotheses.claim: The queue-only candidate preserves the selected relative-action and MEAN_STD transformation under consumer interleavings.
The queue-only candidate also establishes a coherent observation/queue memory cut.
Re-reading observation/epoch and the queue snapshot under the established lock order removes that memory-cut mismatch.

interpretation: Initial constant extraction incorrectly treated OBS_STATE as an isolated literal; source assignment depends on OBS_STR. No worker ran before that failure.

Selected processor reset shadowed the engine reset in the harness namespace. The reset control exposed it; method extraction now restores outer bindings. This was a harness defect, not an upstream reset failure.

limits: Constructed source-body controls, scripted object setup, adapters and echo policy; no learned inference, full-runtime integration or robot confirmation.
Stable observation payloads are a fixture premise. Mutation/ownership of published buffers is not qualified.
No GPU, other normalization modes or trained-RTC guarantee.
No new upstream message, contribution acceptance, customer relationship or comparative-value evidence.
next_action: Keep the concrete reproducer and candidate available. Bind a real incident to installed source/settings and a live owner decision before choosing a broader experiment or production interface expansion.
